mapper.select: select t.* from ( select l.id, 1 as eventType, l.action as action, l.create_time as eventTime, sa1.name as fromAgentName, su1.user_name as fromAgentUserName, sa2.name as toAgentName, su2.user_name as toAgentUserName, su.user_name as operatorName, l.reason as reason, null as dialLogId, null as taskName, null as agentName, null as phone, null as callId, null as callResult, null as talkDuration, null as disposition from customer_pool_log l left join sip_agent sa1 on l.from_agent = sa1.id left join sys_user su1 on sa1.user_id = su1.user_id left join sip_agent sa2 on l.to_agent = sa2.id left join sys_user su2 on sa2.user_id = su2.user_id left join sys_user su on l.operator = su.user_id where l.customer_id = #{customerId} union all select d.id, 2 as eventType, null as action, d.dial_time as eventTime, null as fromAgentName, null as fromAgentUserName, null as toAgentName, null as toAgentUserName, null as operatorName, null as reason, d.id as dialLogId, ct.name as taskName, sa.name as agentName, d.phone as phone, d.call_id as callId, d.call_result as callResult, d.talk_duration as talkDuration, d.disposition as disposition from call_task_dial_log d left join call_task ct on d.task_id = ct.id left join sip_agent sa on d.agent_id = sa.id where d.customer_id = #{customerId} and d.del_flag = 0 ) t order by t.eventTime desc
